purpose: Within each matched clean/noise realization, measure how a prescribed noise-level change changes fixed versus frozen VAD updating.
prior_evidence: Exploratory diagnostic extension motivated by previously viewed development and test outcomes. Six sentences were already used in the prior test; this is NOT an independent validation set or a new benchmark score.
residual: n = original_noisy - clean from aligned NOIZEUS 10 dB pairs. Residual includes any source quantization/scaling discrepancy. No time alignment or gain fitting. Copy original inputs; retain float64 arrays for processing/scoring.
profile_construction: Let N be length and K=800 (0.10 s). MATLAB changeStart=K+floor((N-K)/2)+1. Samples1:changeStart-1 retain gain1. Starting at changeStart, apply a400-sample (50 ms) linear-in-dB ramp including both0and target endpoints, then hold target gain. y_profile=s+gain*n. This controls added level variation, not intrinsic noise stationarity. Constant remixes must be exactly the original WAV samples.

frozen_processing.core: Byte-identical tsnr_enhance.m; all other settings from byte-identical experiment_config.m. No oracle VAD, parameter search, output normalization, resampling or delay fitting.

primary_metrics.STOI: pystoi standard extended=False on unquantized doubles; batch Python after MATLAB

secondary_diagnostics.post_interval: changeStart+400+800:N (after ramp plus100 ms guard); global SNR on this segment only; no short-segment STOI
secondary_diagnostics.tracking: Existing trace.noisePower is sum(D) used BEFORE current frame update. Compare with sum(abs(FFT(window*known_injected_noise))^2) for that same original-support valid frame. Report10log10(estimate/instantaneous injected power), weighted aggregate bias and median absolute frame error. This is a broadband realization-based diagnostic, NOT true expected noise PSD estimation accuracy. Late frames start at/after post_interval firstsample.
secondary_diagnostics.update_proxies: Original clean-energy proxies retained: speech>=-30dB relative to peak valid clean-frame energy, non-speech<=-40dB; middle region unlabelled. They are neither manual VAD annotations nor a perceptual test.

paired_summary: For each sentence, average its two noise-type results for each profile/method; show all6 sentence values, mean, min/max. Main method contrasts selected-original and selected-fixed; changed-minus-constant contrasts describe sensitivity to the prescribed level manipulation. The36 mixtures/overlapping frames are NOT independent experimental units. No significance tests, formal confidence intervals or generalization claims.

preselected_diagnostic_example.reason: First sentence, street condition, rising stress profile selected before scoring; not a best-case choice.

verification_gates: Profile prefix sample-identical; shared initial PSD exactly equal across profiles and methods
No change in pre-transition estimate/decision/update traces
Output prefixes agree with at least2window-length exclusion before transition
fixed output independent of VAD thresholds
Constant profile same as original source waveform and prior10dB test outputs/metrics
All finite outputs, dimensions and frame alignment checked
stopping_rule: Run exactly36specified mixtures and4methods; no outcome-driven redesign or retuning. Fix implementation errors only with recorded amendment; publish all cases, including failures.
